# Rui Bao

University of Pennsylvania

I am a Master of Applied Economics and Data Science (MAEDS) student at the University of Pennsylvania, with a bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of Florida. My interests lie at the intersection of economics, data analytics, and finance, where I use quantitative methods to turn complex information into practical insights.

Through experience in consulting, investment research, and wealth management, I have developed skills in market research, industry analysis, financial evaluation, and strategic problem-solving. I also value social responsibility and enjoy collaborating with people from diverse backgrounds.

I am currently exploring internship and full-time opportunities in data analytics, business analytics, financial analysis, consulting, and applied economics. I welcome opportunities to connect, learn, and contribute to meaningful work.
